fields.name: The Fake Snack
fields.card_task: Pretend to eat a snack but secretly toss it behind you when no one is looking.

fields.name: The Unseen Prize
fields.card_task: Tell someone there’s a prize hidden somewhere, but it doesn’t exist.

fields.name: Invisible Ink
fields.card_task: Write a secret message on your hand and show it to someone as if it's invisible.

fields.name: Lost in Translation
fields.card_task: Pretend to misinterpret something someone says and respond hilariously wrong.

fields.name: The Sneaky Switch
fields.card_task: Swap your drink with someone else's when they aren’t looking.

fields.name: Fake News
fields.card_task: Tell someone a ridiculous rumor about someone else at the party.

fields.name: Hidden Talent
fields.card_task: Claim you can juggle and then dramatically 'fail' at it in a funny way.

fields.name: Mysterious Invitation
fields.card_task: Hand someone an 'invitation' to a made-up event that sounds ridiculous.

fields.name: The Distracted Guest
fields.card_task: Pretend to be on a very important phone call and keep looking around confused.

fields.name: Fake Name Game
fields.card_task: Introduce yourself to someone using a completely made-up name.

fields.name: The Disappearing Snack
fields.card_task: Claim there’s a magical snack that disappears when you say its name.

fields.name: Mysterious Illness
fields.card_task: Act like you’re suffering from a strange but funny 'illness' caused by a snack.

fields.name: The Unseen Guest
fields.card_task: Pretend to have a conversation with an imaginary guest at the party.

fields.name: The Phantom Photographer
fields.card_task: Pretend to take photos of the party and act like you're working for a famous magazine.

fields.name: The Dramatic Exit
fields.card_task: Stage a fake dramatic exit, claiming you can’t stand one more minute at the party.

fields.name: Secret Mission
fields.card_task: Tell someone you’re on a secret mission to find a 'rare' item at the party.

fields.name: The Mysterious Object
fields.card_task: Hand someone an empty box and insist it contains something very valuable.

fields.name: The Invisible Wall
fields.card_task: Pretend to bump into an invisible wall and try to convince someone it's there.

fields.name: Whisper Challenge
fields.card_task: Whisper something absurd to someone, then look shocked when they react.

fields.name: The Fake Illness
fields.card_task: Act like you’re allergic to something absurd, like the color blue.

fields.name: The Mischievous Mascot
fields.card_task: Pretend to be a mascot for a made-up team and make everyone cheer for it.

fields.name: Random Confession
fields.card_task: Pretend to confess something outrageous to someone, like you’re an alien.

fields.name: The Celebrity Look-Alike
fields.card_task: Claim to be a celebrity's long-lost twin and act dramatically.

fields.name: The Surprising Prize
fields.card_task: Hand out 'prizes' that are completely useless (like a paperclip) and act serious.

fields.name: The Wrong Snack
fields.card_task: Hand someone a snack and say it’s something completely different (e.g., popcorn is 'caviar').

fields.name: Compliment Relay
fields.card_task: Compliment three different people in a row without repeating yourself.

fields.name: Dance Dare
fields.card_task: Challenge someone to a 30-second dance-off.

fields.name: Mystery Mingle
fields.card_task: Talk to someone you don't know and find out their favorite movie.

fields.name: Snack Stealer
fields.card_task: Take a snack from someone else's plate without them noticing.

fields.name: Silly Selfie
fields.card_task: Take a funny group selfie with at least three people.

fields.name: Theming Up
fields.card_task: Convince someone to wear a themed accessory you provide (e.g., a hat or scarf).

fields.name: The Joke Exchange
fields.card_task: Tell a joke and make someone laugh; if they don't, make them tell you one.

fields.name: Find the Favorite
fields.card_task: Get someone to tell you their favorite food at the party.

fields.name: Secret Handshake
fields.card_task: Create a secret handshake with someone at the party.

fields.name: Toast of the Night
fields.card_task: Make a toast to the host and get at least three people to join you.

fields.name: Truth or Dare Challenge
fields.card_task: Challenge someone to a quick game of Truth or Dare.

fields.name: Fashion Police
fields.card_task: Pick someone to be the 'best-dressed' at the party and tell them why.

fields.name: Impressionist
fields.card_task: Do an impression of someone at the party and have others guess who it is.

fields.name: The Whisper Challenge
fields.card_task: Whisper something silly to someone and make them laugh without anyone else hearing.

fields.name: The Last Word
fields.card_task: Get the last word in a conversation with someone without them noticing.

fields.name: Silly String Surprise
fields.card_task: Spray someone with silly string without them noticing beforehand.

fields.name: Compliment Corner
fields.card_task: Start a compliment circle where everyone has to say something nice about the person next to them.

fields.name: Blindfolded Snack Test
fields.card_task: Blindfold someone and have them guess three different snacks.

fields.name: Mystery Dance Move
fields.card_task: Create a new dance move and teach it to at least three people.

fields.name: Favorite Drink Finder
fields.card_task: Find someone who shares your favorite drink and take a selfie together.

fields.name: The Social Butterfly
fields.card_task: Introduce two people who don’t know each other.

fields.name: Song Switch
fields.card_task: Convince the DJ or host to play a specific song everyone loves.

fields.name: Surprise Talent Show
fields.card_task: Organize a mini talent show with at least three participants.

fields.name: Caption This!
fields.card_task: Take a photo of a funny moment and have everyone come up with a caption.

fields.name: Guest of Honor
fields.card_task: Nominate someone to be the 'guest of honor' and explain why.

fields.name: Guess the Snack
fields.card_task: Blindfold yourself and guess five snacks from the party.

fields.name: Themed Costume Photo
fields.card_task: Take a group photo in a themed pose (e.g., superhero, classic movie).

fields.name: Confetti Surprise
fields.card_task: Throw confetti on someone while shouting, 'Gotcha!'
